errors.evidence: The figure consists of two separate bar charts, one for the 'PHEME' dataset and one for the 'PolitiFact' dataset. The description incorrectly refers to it as a single bar chart and fails to mention this crucial two-part structure.

errors.text_span: The horizontal axis lists the categories: “Our”, “W/o select”, “W/o text”, “W/o cognition”, and “W/o emotion”
errors.evidence: The list of categories on the horizontal axis is incomplete; it omits the "w/o comments" category.
The categories on the x-axis are not ordered alphabetically. The order is 'Ours', 'w/o comments', 'w/o text', etc.

errors.text_span: with tick intervals of 5 percentage points
errors.evidence: The tick intervals on the vertical axis are 2.5 percentage points (e.g., 75.0, 77.5, 80.0), not 5.
The bars are not all blue. They have a range of colors including dark red, orange, and yellow, in addition to shades of blue.

errors.text_span: The bar for “Our” W/o comments has a value of 86.82%
errors.evidence: The description nonsensically combines two distinct categories, 'Ours' and 'w/o comments'. The value 86.82% corresponds to the 'w/o comments' bar in the PHEME chart, not this fabricated combined category.

errors.text_span: the tallest bar, “Our” W/o emotion, reaches a value of 90.57%
errors.evidence: The description nonsensically combines two distinct categories, 'Ours' and 'w/o emotion'. The value 90.57% corresponds to the 'Ours' bar in the PolitiFact chart, which is indeed the tallest bar, but the category is misidentified.

errors.text_span: The bar for “W/o text” has a value of 84.91%
errors.evidence: The value 84.91% corresponds to the 'w/o emotion' category in the PolitiFact chart, not the 'W/o text' category.

errors.text_span: with the shortest bar, “W/o select”, having a value of 83.02%
errors.evidence: This claim is incorrect in three ways: 1) The shortest bar in the figure is 'w/o text' in the PHEME chart (80.10%). 2) The category 'W/o select' is not the shortest. 3) The value 83.02% belongs to the 'w/o text' category in the PolitiFact chart.
